verdict.rationale: Steel's CLI is documented to run full multi-step browser workflows end-to-end from the terminal: start a session, navigate, click/fill/type, extract, and stop. That gives scriptable, repeatable step sequences rather than one-shot prompts. The evidence shows no first-party workflow construct with loops, conditionals, or parameters, so that control flow would have to come from the user's own shell or code. Missing for 10: documented loop/conditional constructs, parameterized workflow definitions, saved and reusable workflow templates, and independent corroboration.
